generation.final_prompt:
Rendering style:
Create an authored editorial illustration for a serious technology newspaper.

Direction:
- authored editorial print language
- deliberate simplified shapes with clear focal hierarchy
- restrained limited palette
- subtle physical print texture
- controlled abstraction and strong negative space
- non-photorealistic but factually grounded representation
- newspaper and social-card readability

Fixed factual and safety restrictions:
- Do not render visible text, captions, headlines, or newspaper typography.
- Do not render logos or trademarks.
- Do not fabricate visible factual evidence.
- Do not render interfaces or screenshots.
- Do not imitate a named or living artist.

Profile-specific exclusions:
- glossy CGI
- luxury product render
- generic futuristic concept art
- cyberpunk or neon
- glowing circuit-board decoration
- floating particles
- heroic centered hardware
- server rack treated as monument or skyscraper
- generic server room
- advertising composition
- airbrushed gradients
- synthetic chrome
- excessive pseudo-technical detail
- malformed or visible text
- labels
- diagrams with words

Exact source facts:
Title: FOUR TOP GOOGLE AI RESEARCHERS FORM NEW START-UP
Summary: Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, Quoc Le, and Oriol Vinyals have left Google to start a company called Discovery Loop. The team aims to build AI that can improve itself with little or no help from humans. Google plans to collaborate with the new startup and has agreed to provide the computing power it needs to build its AI technologies for at least the next year. Discovery Loop will operate as a public benefit corporation.

Editorial idea:
A powerful research group leaves a major institution while retaining a working connection to it, turning a corporate departure into a story about talent, independence, and continued dependence on shared infrastructure.

Central subject:
The four Google researchers forming Discovery Loop

Visual relationship:
The researchers' departure and Google's continued support are shown as a new venture branching away from its former institution while remaining connected to the computing resources that enabled it.

Composition:
A large institutional structure occupies one side of the composition, with four distinct paths peeling away toward a smaller new structure; one clearly grounded infrastructural connection remains between them, representing Google's agreement to provide computing power.

Permitted literal elements:
four departing researchers represented as four paths or figures
a large established research institution
a smaller new public-benefit company
a visible computing-resource connection between the two
an outward branching motion suggesting independence

Abstraction level:
medium

Story-specific forbidden elements:
racks
chips
laptops
robots
clouds
shields
arrows
charts
skyscrapers
chess
handshakes
split-screen conflict
logos
rendered text
unsupported physical details

Likely failure modes to avoid:
depicting the startup as fully independent with no continuing Google relationship
reducing the story to generic AI imagery
showing literal corporate logos or readable labels
inventing offices, equipment, or personal appearances

Global factual restrictions:
Do not fabricate visible factual evidence. Do not imitate a named or living artist. Do not render interfaces or screenshots.
Do not render any words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, annotations, signage, diagrams with text, logos, watermarks, or pseudo-writing anywhere in the image.
If the concept cannot be represented without visible text, represent the relationship through shape, scale, spacing, direction, grouping, interruption, containment, or contrast instead.
